title: Session Layer
markdown:
The **Session Layer** (Layer 5) is the network dialog controller. It establishes, maintains, and synchronizes interactions between communicating applications.

### Primary Responsibilities

- **Dialog Control** — Manages session modes (half-duplex or full-duplex communication between processes).
- **Synchronization** — Inserts **checkpoints (synchronization points)** into long data streams. If a failure occurs, transmission can resume from the last validated checkpoint rather than restarting from the beginning.
